description_en: Updates the configuration of an endpoint group
description_zh: 修改终端节点组配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun ga update-endpoint-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1dmlohjjz4kqaun0000 --endpoint-group-region cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateEndpointGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
A client-generated token to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The token must be unique across requests and can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId is unique for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the endpoint group.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters long, start with a letter or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点组的名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the endpoint group.

The description can be up to 200 characters long and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点组描述信息。

描述长度最大200字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the endpoint group is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 终端节点组所属的地域ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_region

parameters.help_en: The weight of the endpoint group when the listener is associated with multiple endpoint groups
parameters.help_zh: 监听有多个终端节点组时的权重
parameters.name: traffic_percentage

parameters.help_en: The interval between health checks, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 健康检查的时间间隔。单位：秒。取值范围：1-50
parameters.name: health_check_interval_seconds

parameters.help_en: The port used for health checks. Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh: 健康检查的端口。取值范围：1~65535
parameters.name: health_check_port

parameters.help_en:
The protocol for health checks. Valid values:

tcp or TCP

http or HTTP

https or HTTPS
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查的协议。取值：

tcp或TCP：TCP协议。

http或HTTP：HTTP协议。

https或HTTPS：HTTPS协议
parameters.name: health_check_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive successful or failed health checks required to change an endpoint's health status.

Valid values: 2 to 10
parameters.help_zh:
针对健康检查状态变化所需要的连续健康检查次数，即从成功到失败的连续健康检查失败次数或从失败到成功的连续健康检查成功次数。

取值范围：2~10
parameters.name: threshold_count

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to preserve client source IP addresses. Valid values:

true: Preserves client source IP addresses.

false (default): Does not preserve client source IP addresses.

For endpoint groups of TCP or UDP listeners, this feature is disabled by default but can be enabled if needed.

For endpoint groups of HTTP or HTTPS listeners, client source IP addresses are preserved by default. The client IP addresses are retrieved from the X-Forwarded-For header. You cannot disable this feature.

You cannot set both `EnableClientIPPreservation` and `EnableProxyProtocol` to `true`.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.help_zh:
是否使用自动获取方式开启保持客户端源 IP 功能，取值：

true：开启保持客户端源 IP 功能。

false（默认值）：不开启保持客户端源IP功能。


UDP/TCP 监听对应的终端节点组默认不开启保持客户端源IP，您可根据业务需要配置。
HTTP（S）监听对应的终端节点组默认开启保持客户端源IP，通过X-Forwarded-For头字段获取。不支持关闭。
EnableClientIPPreservation与 EnableProxyProtocol不能同时为 true。
更多信息请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.name: enable_client_ip_preservation

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the Proxy Protocol to preserve client source IP addresses. Valid values:

true: Preserves client source IP addresses.

false (default): Does not preserve client source IP addresses.

You can configure this parameter only for endpoint groups of TCP listeners.

You cannot set both `EnableClientIPPreservation` and `EnableProxyProtocol` to `true`.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.help_zh:
是否使用ProxyProtocol方式开启保持客户端源IP功能，取值：

true：开启保持客户端源IP功能。

false（默认值）：不开启保持客户端源IP功能。
仅支持TCP监听对应的终端节点组配置。
EnableClientIPPreservation与 EnableProxyProtocol不能同时为 true。
更多信息请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.name: enable_proxy_protocol

fields.help_en: Enter an IP address, a domain name, or an instance ID based on the value of the `Type` parameter
fields.help_zh: 根据Type（终端节点类型）输入对应的IP、域名或实例ID
fields.name: endpoint

fields.help_en: 端点配置中的服务提供商
fields.help_zh: 端点配置中的服务提供商
fields.name: provider

fields.help_en:
The private IP address of the elastic network interface.

If the endpoint type is ENI, you can specify this parameter. If you omit this parameter, the primary private IP address of the ENI is used
fields.help_zh:
弹性网卡的私网IP地址。

当终端节点类型为ENI时，可以选择配置该参数，如果不配置默认为ENI的主私网IP地址
fields.name: sub_address

fields.help_en:
The type of endpoint. Valid values:

Domain: a custom domain name.

Ip: a custom IP address.

IpTarget: a custom private IP address.

PublicIp: an Alibaba Cloud public IP address.

ECS: an ECS instance.

SLB: an SLB instance.

ALB: an ALB instance.

OSS: an OSS instance.

ENI: an elastic network interface.

NLB: an NLB instance.

If the endpoint type is ECS, ENI, SLB, or IpTarget, and the service-linked role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service-linked role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaVpcEndpoint.

If the endpoint type is ALB, and the service-linked role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service-linked role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaAlb.

If the endpoint type is OSS, and the service-linked role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service-linked role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaOss.

If the endpoint type is NLB, and the service-linked role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service-linked role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaNlb.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178360.html
fields.help_zh:
终端节点类型，取值：
Domain：自定义域名。
Ip：自定义IP。
IpTarget：自定义私网IP。
PublicIp：阿里云公网IP。
ECS：阿里云ECS实例。
SLB：阿里云SLB实例。
ALB：阿里云ALB实例。
OSS：阿里云OSS实例。
ENI：阿里云弹性网卡。
NLB：阿里云NLB实例。

终端节点类型取值为ECS、ENI、SLB、ALB、NLB或IpTarget时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaVpcEndpoint的服务关联角色。
终端节点类型取值为ALB时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaAlb的服务关联角色。
终端节点类型取值为OSS时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaOss的服务关联角色。
终端节点类型取值为NLB时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaNlb的服务关联角色。
更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178360.html
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: A list of vSwitches in the VPC
fields.name: vswitchids

fields.help_en:
The ID of the VPC.

You can specify at most one VPC ID for an endpoint group that is associated with an intelligent routing listener.

This parameter is required only when the endpoint type is IpTarget
fields.help_zh:
专有网络ID。

在智能路由类型监听的某个终端节点组中，您最多可以输入1个专有网络ID。
仅当终端节点类型为IpTarget时有效且必填
fields.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en:
The weight of the endpoint.

Valid values: 0 to 255.

If you set the weight of an endpoint to 0, Global Accelerator stops distributing traffic to the endpoint. Proceed with caution
fields.help_zh:
终端节点的权重。

取值范围：0~255。

如果某个终端节点的权重设置为0，全球加速将终止向该终端节点分发流量，请您谨慎操作
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en:
The backend service protocol. Valid values:

HTTP

HTTPS

You can configure this parameter only for endpoint groups of HTTP or HTTPS listeners.

For an HTTP listener, the backend service protocol must be HTTP
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务协议。取值：

HTTP
HTTPS

仅为HTTP或HTTPS协议的监听实例创建终端节点组时才支持配置该项。
对于HTTP协议的监听实例，后端服务协议支持且仅支持HTTP
parameters.name: endpoint_request_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The version of the backend service protocol. Valid values:

HTTP1.1

HTTP2

You can configure this parameter only when `EndpointRequestProtocol` is set to HTTPS
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务协议版本。取值：

HTTP1.1

HTTP2

仅当EndpointRequestProtocol（后端服务协议）值为HTTPS时，支持配置终端节点后端服务协议版本
parameters.name: endpoint_protocol_version

fields.help_en: The endpoint port in the port override settings
fields.help_zh: 配置端口映射中的终端节点端口
fields.name: endpoint_port

fields.help_en:
The listener port in the port override settings.

For TCP listeners, virtual endpoint groups do not support port overrides. If a listener is already associated with a virtual endpoint group, you cannot configure port overrides for the default endpoint group. If the default endpoint group has port overrides configured, you cannot add a virtual endpoint group.

After you configure port overrides, you can change the listener protocol only between HTTP and HTTPS.

The updated listener port range must include all listener ports in the configured port overrides. For example, if the listener port range is 80-82 and port overrides are configured to map the ports to endpoint ports 100-102, you cannot update the listener port range to 80-81
fields.help_zh:
配置端口映射中的监听端口。

对于TCP监听：虚拟终端节点组不支持配置端口映射。如果监听下已存在虚拟终端节点组，则默认终端节点组无法配置端口映射。如果默认终端节点组已配置端口映射，则无法添加虚拟终端节点组。
配置端口映射后，后续监听变更时有以下限制：除HTTP和HTTPS之间的协议切换以外，不支持修改监听协议。
监听端口：您修改的监听端口范围必须包含当前所配置端口映射的全量监听端口。例如，当监听端口范围为80-82，并配置端口映射至终端节点端口100-102时，后续修改监听端口范围时，不支持修改为80-81
fields.name: listener_port
